jobs.description:
As a 
field service engineer, you'll be the technical expert customers rely on to keep their industrial equipment running smoothly.
 

You'll work both 
on-site at customer facilities across the EMEA region and 
at the technical service center in Merchtem, combining hands-on troubleshooting, maintenance, and repairs with direct customer support.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Technical troubleshooting: Diagnose, analyze, and resolve issues with industrial measurement equipment, electronic systems, and process control technologies. 

• Installation & commissioning: Install, configure, and commission advanced technical equipment at customer sites throughout the EMEA region. 

• Maintenance & repairs: Perform technical repairs, preventive maintenance, and failure analysis, both on-site and at the workshop in Merchtem. 

• Customer support: Provide professional technical assistance, both remotely and in person, ensuring customers receive efficient and reliable solutions. 

• Technical training: Guide customers in the correct use, maintenance, and operation of their equipment. 

• Continuous improvement: Collaborate with international engineering and technical teams to identify recurring issues and contribute to product and service improvements. 

• Reporting & follow-up: Document technical interventions, maintain accurate service records, and take ownership of your assigned cases from start to finish.  

You'll spend approximately 
40–50% of your time travelling internationally, while the remaining time will mainly be dedicated to technical repairs, diagnostics, and support activities at the Merchtem service center.

What makes you a great match?
 
 

• You are 
fluent in Dutch, French, English, and German, allowing you to communicate confidently with customers and colleagues across the EMEA region. 

• You have a solid understanding of 
electrical systems, industrial electronics, and wiring. 

• You have hands-on experience in 
troubleshooting and repairing industrial electronics or control systems. 

• Ideally, you have at least 
2 years of experience in field service, industrial maintenance, or a manufacturing environment. 

• Experience with 
measurement equipment, process control systems, or industrial communication protocols (Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, and PROFIBUS) is a strong advantage. 

• You're 
independent, proactive, and reliable, taking full ownership of your tasks and following through on your commitments. 

• You're 
customer-oriented and communicative, keeping customers and colleagues informed throughout the process. 

• You're comfortable working with 
targets, KPIs, and service deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards. 

• You're flexible and enthusiastic about 
international travel (approximately 50%), including overnight stays across the EMEA region. 

• You hold a 
valid driver's license and have a clean driving record.

Shape the architecture behind the next generation of AI supercomputers.
 

Join imec and design the future of AI computing
 

What if your architectural decisions could influence the future of artificial intelligence at the scale of the world's most advanced computing systems?
At imec, you will work at the intersection of AI, semiconductor innovation, and large-scale computing architectures. Together with leading experts in computing systems, chip technology, software, and artificial intelligence, you will help define how future AI infrastructure is built, optimized, and scaled.
This is not a product maintenance role. It is an opportunity to explore breakthrough architectures that could shape the next decade of AI and high-performance computing.
 

What you will do
 

As a Principal AI & High-Performance Computing Architect, you will drive innovation across the entire computing stack, from AI applications and system software to processors, accelerators, and semiconductor technologies.
You will create models, simulations, and design explorations that help identify the most promising paths toward future AI computing systems that deliver significant improvements in performance, energy efficiency, and sustainability.
Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Exploring architectural solutions for next-generation AI and high-performance computing clusters. 

• Analysing the behaviour and performance characteristics of large-scale AI workloads. 

• Developing performance models that identify bottlenecks and opportunities for innovation. 

• Evaluating future processor, accelerator, memory, and system designs. 

• Collaborating with experts in computer architecture, AI, semiconductor technology, system software, and modelling. 

• Defining requirements for future AI computing platforms and processor architectures. 

• Guiding strategic research directions through data-driven performance analysis and projections. 

• Contributing to breakthrough innovations that improve performance, energy efficiency, operational cost, and environmental impact. 

Who you are
 
 

• Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or relevant STEM degree, with at least around 8 years of experience.   

• Experience with performance analysis, engineering, and optimization of HPC applications, such as molecular dynamics and computational fluid dynamics,  

• Experience in AI for HPC is a plus.   

• Experience with distributed AI/ML applications, such as LLM training and inference.   

• Experience in system performance modeling ranging from a single device (e.g. a GPU) to a machine scale (e.g. a cluster).  

• Good understanding of GPU (preferably XPU) system architectures, distributed programming models, runtime resource management, and microarchitecture.   

• Strong programming ability in C++ and Python. CUDA knowledge is considered a plus.   

• Your communication and interpersonal skills enable you to work in a dynamic, distributed team. You actively share experiences and knowledge with colleagues. A history of mentoring more junior engineers and interns is a huge plus.   

• We are looking for your excellent communication skills in English, as you will work in a multicultural team and together with our partners.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Solution Architect to contribute to the ongoing evolution of its wealth management platform (Gwp - Gambit Wealth Platform).

The Solution Architect will play a key role in ensuring architectural consistency, technical governance and alignment across multiple development squads.

The main objective is to simplify and optimise the existing architecture while improving the platform's maintainability, scalability and autonomy.
Key responsibilities

• Ensure architectural consistency and alignment across multiple development squads

• Lead and facilitate Architecture Chapter meetings, promoting technical standards and best practices

• Support Technical Leads and development teams in making architectural decisions

• Analyse the existing architecture and identify opportunities to improve maintainability, performance and scalability

• Rationalise and consolidate MicroServices to reduce technical complexity and simplify operations, hosting, testing and integration

• Design, simplify and standardise APIs and integration mechanisms

• Document architectural decisions, evaluate technical alternatives and identify potential trade-offs

• Collaborate closely with developers, Technical Leads, Business Analysts and business stakeholders

• Reduce external dependencies and improve the platform's technical and functional autonomy

• Contribute to the continuous improvement and long-term evolution of the Gwp platform

Technical environment

• Backend development:

• C# / .NET Core

• Entity Framework

• MicroServices architecture

• Architecture & API design:

• REST APIs / OpenAPI

• Asyncapi / Typespec

• ArchiMate / UML

• Enterprise Architect

• Cloud & DevOps:

• Microsoft Azure DevOps

• Docker / Kubernetes

• Helm

• CI/CD

• Data & messaging:

• PostgreSQL

• Apache Kafka

• Testing:NUnit / xUnit

Ideal candidate

We are looking for a hands-on, pragmatic and technically strong Solution Architect who can combine architectural vision with a deep understanding of software development.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with multiple squads, challenging existing architectural decisions and driving improvements across a complex software platform.

This is a cross-functional Solution Architect position, not simply a senior .NET developer or technical lead role.

• Strong experience in software development within the Microsoft .NET ecosystem, ideally 10+ years

• Proven experience as a Solution Architect, ideally 3-5 years or more

• Solid understanding of distributed systems, MicroServices and API architecture

• Experience in analysing, simplifying and modernising complex existing architectures

• Good knowledge of containerisation, DevOps practices and cloud environments

• Ability to challenge technical decisions and propose pragmatic, scalable and maintainable solutions

• Experience working across multiple development teams or squads

• Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to balance technical requirements, business needs and long-term architectural objectives

• Fluent in French and English (both required)

 

Nice to have

• Experience with architectural governance and Architecture Chapters

• Knowledge of enterprise architecture methodologies and modelling tools

Oversee contractor-led tool installations for the Málaga cleanroom (Fab 5) project, with a focus on safety and conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines. 

 

What you will doFor the Málaga Fab 5 project, tool installations will be performed by the contractor. imec’s role focuses on safety oversight and validating that the installations conform to imec’s required standards and guidelines. That’s where you come in. Onboarding and training will take place in Leuven, Belgium until mid-2028, after which the position location will transfer to Málaga, Spain.  
As Project Lead, your role combines contractor oversight, safety follow-up and installation conformity validation on behalf of imec. 
The contractor is responsible for installation execution and day-to-day coordination of the installation works. You will monitor progress, review safety and quality matters, and coordinate interfaces with imec stakeholders, keeping a clear distinction between contractor execution and imec oversight. 
Your focus is to validate conformity with imec’s installation standards, guidelines and safety requirements. You will review contractor deliverables and installation evidence, follow up deviations and corrective actions, and support installation acceptance by imec rather than directly managing execution. 
You will: 
 
 

• Oversee contractor-led installations and coordinate interfaces with imec 

• Review contractor schedules and monitor progress against agreed milestones 

• Flag scope deviations and their impact on timelines, budgets and priorities 

• Validate installation conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines through reviews, inspections and supporting records 

• Provide safety oversight and follow up contractor actions on safety and quality findings 

• Keep internal stakeholders and external partners informed 

• Escalate risks and non-conformities, track corrective actions and review evidence for installation acceptance 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electromechanical Engineering.  

• You have at least 5 years of relevant technical experience.  

• You have experience overseeing contractor-led technical projects and reviewing installations against defined standards and guidelines.  

• You communicate openly and proactively with both internal customers and external partners about the status of ongoing work, and you escalate issues promptly when needed.  

• You adapt easily to changes and time pressure and combine a practical mindset with a strong focus on safety, quality and conformity.  

• You are fluent in English and Spanish.

Sabena Engineering is a leading independent and international aviation solutions provider for civil and military operators. 
 

Our capabilities cover the main aircraft types, including Airbus, Boeing, Lockheed, regional and military aircraft and rotor aircraft. With our unique and innovative solutions to both regular and complex needs, Sabena Engineering is all set to grow as a worldwide proximity partner, bringing its expertise wherever needed. SABCA offers a full range of services to the civil, space and military aviation markets and recently expanded into the commercial Unmanned Autonomous Systems market as an integrator of aerospace-grade solutions for the industry. 
 

Sabena Aerospace & SABCA are part of a unique industrial ecosystem in the Belgian aerospace industry which is owned by Sabena Aerospace (holding company) and by the Société Fédérale de Participations et d’Investissements (SFPI/FPIM).
 

Are you ready to join us?
 

Your Main Responsibilities:
 

Reporting to the Head of Engine Services, you will be required to perform the following:

• Ability to converse and understand English language at a high level

• You have a part 66 B1, B1/B2, B1/C or B1/B2/ C license or equivalent shop training/experience on CFM56 and/or V2500 and/or LEAP 1A/1B engines

A background in a law firm or consultancy, or a specific HR degree, is welcome but not required.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

What you will do
 
 

• Operate and monitor high-tech automated machines to ensure uninterrupted production. 

• Maintain accurate performance and efficiency of the tools as qualified user. 

• Follow and understand procedures, instructions and WoW quickly and apply them correctly. 

• Able to act correctly and clearly under pressure and ask support when needed.  

• Quickly identify and report any issues or malfunctions to First Line Support (FLS) or WIP lead. 

• Follow safety and operational procedures to maintain a secure and efficient work environment. 

• Communicate in clear language and understandable terms (also in English) and participate actively in shift handover.  

• Keep everything tidy according to 5S rules. 

• Refill chemicals. 

Who you are
 
 

• Experience in operations environment or a similar field is preferred, but we focus on potential. 

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills. 

• Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively. 

• Good communication and teamwork skills. 

• Proactive, detail-oriented and dynamic. 

• Knowledge of English  

Below is an example of the shift schedule, providing a clear understanding of the work hours and rotation you can expect in this role:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift (06:15 – 14:15) from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift (21:45 – 06:30) from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift (14:00 – 22:00) from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h - (06:30 – 18:30)  

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday, you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift (14:00 – 22:00). 

• Week X: You work from Monday to Friday in the early shift. (06:15 – 14:15).
